title: Nchumu wo saseka ku tlurisa
description: Muzi u rhandza ku aka hi swo tlangisa swa yena. Kambe loko a swi siya ekaya loko a ya endzela Kokwana, u hlangana ni swin’wana swo hlawuleka swinene hi mayelana na misava. Kutani a dyondza swin’wana swintshwa hi mayelana na yena n’wini.
